problem.input: An exact-transfer instance with a deterministic canonical feedback interface B whose raw width may exceed floor(log2 L).
problem.question: When the frozen downstream dependency structure over B is exactly disconnected, can the interface be solved and reconstructed as an exact factorized portfolio with polynomial total representation/work, without materializing the Cartesian product of local interface states?

formal_objects.frozen_downstream_relations: R = {R_a}; each R_a has an explicit scope scope(R_a) subseteq B plus its exact local semantics/message contract
formal_objects.dependency_hypergraph: H_B has vertex set B and one hyperedge scope(R_a) for every frozen downstream relation/message that can affect transfer or reconstruction
formal_objects.canonical_components: C_1,...,C_t are the connected components of H_B under frozen deterministic ordering
formal_objects.separation_condition: Every frozen downstream relation/message/reconstruction obligation has scope entirely inside exactly one B_j; no relation spans two components.
formal_objects.local_exact_state: Q_j is the exact admitted local interface representation for component B_j, using only a preregistered exact language (raw conditioning when |B_j|<=floor(log2 L), affine syndrome quotient from the sealed P1 theorem, or another separately sealed exact local carrier explicitly named before the run).
formal_objects.portfolio_representation: Q = [Q_1,...,Q_t] stored as a tuple/list of independent component records, never as the Cartesian product Q_1 x ... x Q_t.

theorem_target.statement: If H_B is exactly disconnected into C_1,...,C_t, every frozen downstream relation/message/reconstruction obligation is component-local, and every component B_j has an exact local carrier Q_j with polynomial construction/solve/reconstruction/verification cost and polynomial encoded size, then global exact transfer can be performed by the factorized portfolio [Q_1,...,Q_t] with no Cartesian-product materialization.
theorem_target.exactness_obligation: SAT/transfer/reconstruction semantics of the whole admitted instance equal the conjunction/product of the independent component semantics because the B_j are disjoint and no frozen exact downstream obligation couples two components.
theorem_target.decision_rule: If any component returns certified conflict/UNSAT under its exact local semantics, global result is conflict/UNSAT. Otherwise combine independently reconstructed component witnesses with the unchanged non-interface witness data; disjointness guarantees consistency.
theorem_target.representation_bound: encoded_size(Q) = O(sum_j encoded_size(Q_j) + description(H_B)); product_j |Q_j| may be exponential and is not materialized.
theorem_target.runtime_bound: T_total = T_build(H_B) + sum_j(T_construct_j + T_solve_j + T_reconstruct_j + T_verify_j) + polynomial glue/replay overhead.
theorem_target.required_conclusion: If every summand is polynomial in the original encoded input length L and the number/description of components is polynomial, then T_total and certificate bytes are polynomial in L.

mandatory_gates.G1_FROZEN_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH: H_B and all scopes are derived deterministically from frozen exact downstream contracts before candidate solving; no edge may be removed because it is inconvenient.
mandatory_gates.G2_COMPLETE_SCOPE_COVERAGE: Every exact downstream transfer/message/reconstruction observable is assigned to a component and independently replayed; omitted observables fail closed.
mandatory_gates.G3_NO_CROSS_COMPONENT_RELATION: Any exact relation/message whose scope intersects two proposed components forces those components to merge; candidate may not ignore or approximate the coupling.
mandatory_gates.G4_LOCAL_CARRIER_AUTHORITY: Each Q_j must cite a preregistered/sealed exact carrier. Unknown connected components return OPEN_UNSUPPORTED_LOCAL_CARRIER.
mandatory_gates.G5_NO_PRODUCT_MATERIALIZATION: Implementation/checker must prove that no Cartesian product of component states/rows is constructed, enumerated, counted as hidden discovery work, or serialized as a certificate.
mandatory_gates.G6_EXACT_WITNESS_COMPOSITION: Local witnesses must combine into one original-semantics witness; all original clauses/relations must replay successfully.
mandatory_gates.G7_EXACT_UNSAT_RULE: Global UNSAT/conflict may be asserted only from an independently replayable local certified conflict or another preregistered exact proof; absence of a local witness is not enough.
mandatory_gates.G8_COMPLEXITY_ACCOUNTING: Construction, dependency discovery, all local solves, reconstruction, verifier work, and certificate bytes are bounded in original input length L.
mandatory_gates.G9_FAIL_CLOSED: Connected wide interfaces or components without an admitted exact carrier return OPEN, never exponential fallback disguised as polynomial transfer.
mandatory_gates.G10_REGRESSION: Baseline Trinity Sovereign, sealed unicyclic, canonical logarithmic feedback, and affine wide-interface quotient gates remain green and unchanged.

positive_controls.PCTRL_MANY_DISCONNECTED_SMALL_COMPONENTS: Use t growing disjoint feedback components, each individually admitted under the raw-log-width carrier, while product_j |Q_j| is exponentially large in t; require portfolio size/work to remain additive.
positive_controls.PCTRL_MIXED_LOCAL_CARRIERS: Use disjoint components where at least one uses raw-log-width conditioning and at least one uses the sealed affine-syndrome quotient; verify exact composition without converting either to raw assignment space.
positive_controls.PCTRL_ONE_LOCAL_UNSAT: All but one components are SAT; one component has an exact replayable conflict. Global result must be UNSAT/conflict without exploring products of other component states.

negative_controls.NCTRL_SINGLE_CROSS_COUPLING: Add one exact downstream relation whose scope touches two former components; canonical H_B must merge them and the old factorization must be rejected.
negative_controls.NCTRL_HIDDEN_RECONSTRUCTION_COUPLING: Decision messages look factorized but witness reconstruction reads variables from two blocks; scope audit must detect the coupling and reject separation.
negative_controls.NCTRL_PRODUCT_ENUMERATOR: A candidate that explicitly loops over tuples in Q_1 x ... x Q_t fails even when finite controls are small.
negative_controls.NCTRL_UNKNOWN_CONNECTED_WIDE_CORE: A connected wide component outside every sealed local carrier must return OPEN_UNSUPPORTED_LOCAL_CARRIER.

promotion_rule.scope: Only the explicitly admitted exactly disconnected feedback-interface class may be promoted to a scoped transfer theorem.
forbidden: automatic promotion of the global APMA frontier

next_step_after_freeze: Implement a minimal source-guarded factorized-portfolio candidate plus an independently written checker. The implementation must reuse sealed local carriers and expose counters proving zero Cartesian-product materialization.
